kind: Actual repository Live2D ZIP validator, preview utility, and runtime browser inspection
limits: This standalone harness does not test AIRI model storage, Electron selection, stage persistence, physics, or speech timing. The animation probe exercises SDK playback, not the full AIRI plugin combination.
Browser distributions use the exact installed package versions. Imports share their real globals.
Runtime effect checks cover requested parameter boundaries. Only explicitly supplied named states add intermediate or combined-state coverage.
A non-empty render requires visual review of the saved PNGs.

sources.purpose: SDK breath disabling behavior reference, not the full AIRI motion-plugin runtime

pointer.scope: Real Chromium mouse.move events forwarded through the production focusLive2DModelAt adapter. Eye mesh boundary vertices remain fixed. No desktop-global pointer bridge.

media.scope: Actual browser canvas recording of DOM mouse focus and one SDK Yawn motion.

limits: Standalone renderer and SDK playback. Full AIRI stores, speech timing, OS pointer forwarding, and model selection are not exercised.
